Project 01 · Major Project, 2026

DeepTrust: Explainable Multimodal Deepfake Detection

Built a multimodal deep learning system to detect synthetic and manipulated content across video, image, audio, AI-generated text, documents and fake news — documented in an IEEE-format research paper.

Python TensorFlow Computer Vision NLP Explainable AI 92.43% Video/Image 99.01% Fake News 88.50% Document
GitHub IEEE Paper
Overview

An explainable multimodal deepfake detection framework capable of analyzing five distinct media modalities — video/image, documents, AI-generated text, audio and fake news — under one unified system, formally documented in an IEEE-format paper.

Problem Statement

Generative AI has enabled realistic synthetic media across video, voice, text and news articles, making single-modality detectors insufficient. DeepTrust addresses cross-modal misinformation with transparent, explainable predictions.

Modality Accuracy Results
Video / Image: 92.43% Document Forgery: 88.50% AI-Generated Text: 88.20% Audio Deepfake: 85.17% Fake News: 99.01%
Architecture / Workflow

Ingest suspect media input (video, image, document, audio clip, text or news article).

Route inputs to modality-specific feature extraction and preprocessing pipelines.

Run TensorFlow deep learning and computer vision/NLP classifiers across each modality.

Generate authenticity confidence scores paired with explainable verification indicators.

Key Highlights
  • Unified detection across 5 media modalities
  • Explainable predictions for user trust
  • High cross-domain accuracy (up to 99.01%)
  • Documented in IEEE research paper format
Learning Outcomes
  • Multimodal deep learning architecture design
  • Computer vision & audio/text forgery analysis
  • Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation techniques
  • Academic research & IEEE documentation
💬
Project 02 · Deep Learning, NLP

Spam SMS Detection using BiLSTM

Built an end-to-end Bidirectional LSTM neural network that classifies SMS messages as Spam or Ham, achieving 98.74% accuracy and 98.62% ROC-AUC on 1,112 test messages with only 4 false positives.

Python TensorFlow BiLSTM NLP 98.74% Accuracy 97.20% Precision 95.21% F1 98.62% ROC-AUC
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

An end-to-end NLP sequence classification system powered by a Bidirectional LSTM network trained with Adam optimizer and binary cross-entropy loss to distinguish legitimate messages (Ham) from Spam.

Evaluation on 1,112 Test Messages
  • Accuracy: 98.74%
  • Precision: 97.20% (only 4 false positives)
  • Recall: 93.29%
  • F1-Score: 95.21%
  • ROC-AUC: 98.62%
Pipeline Architecture

Text cleaning and normalization of raw SMS messages.

Tokenization and sequence padding to uniform input lengths.

Word Embedding layer followed by Bidirectional LSTM sequence modeling.

Dense (ReLU) representation and Sigmoid output trained with Adam & binary cross-entropy.

Key Features
  • Bidirectional context capture across SMS sequences
  • Ultra-low false positive rate (4 out of 1,112)
  • Complete preprocessing-to-inference NLP pipeline
Learning Outcomes
  • Sequence modeling with LSTM & BiLSTM networks
  • NLP tokenization, padding and embeddings
  • Precision-recall trade-off & ROC-AUC evaluation

Project 05

Sign Language Recognition System

A computer vision and deep learning system that recognizes hand gestures in real time and converts them into readable text, helping bridge communication between hearing-impaired individuals and others.

Python OpenCV MediaPipe TensorFlow / PyTorch NumPy
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

Detects hand landmarks, recognizes sign language gestures in real time, and converts them into readable text using artificial intelligence and computer vision.

Problem Statement

Communication between hearing-impaired individuals and people who don't understand sign language can be challenging. This project provides an AI-powered solution that translates gestures into text instantly.

Key Features
  • Real-time gesture recognition
  • Hand landmark detection and tracking
  • Gesture classification
  • Live webcam support
  • Text generation from gestures
  • AI-based prediction with high recognition accuracy
  • User-friendly interface
Architecture / Workflow

Capture live video using the webcam.

Detect hand landmarks in real time using MediaPipe.

Preprocess the captured images for the model.

Extract important gesture features.

Predict the gesture using a trained deep learning model.

Display the corresponding text output on screen.

Challenges Faced
  • Collecting quality gesture datasets
  • Improving model accuracy
  • Handling different lighting conditions
  • Recognizing similar hand gestures
  • Reducing prediction latency
Learning Outcomes
  • Computer vision fundamentals
  • Image preprocessing and feature extraction
  • Deep learning model development
  • Real-time AI application development
  • MediaPipe integration
Future Enhancements
  • Voice output generation
  • Sentence-level prediction
  • Multi-language support
  • Mobile application and cloud deployment
  • Higher accuracy using advanced AI models

Project 06

House Rental Management System

A web-based DBMS application that simplifies rental property management — landlords manage listings and tenants, while users browse houses and submit rental requests, all backed by a relational database.

HTML CSS JavaScript PHP MySQL XAMPP
GitHub Live Demo
Overview

Simplifies rental property management by letting landlords add, update and remove listings, while tenants search available houses and submit rental requests through a centralized, database-driven system.

Problem Statement

Traditional rental management relies on manual record-keeping, which makes it hard to organize tenant information, property listings and rental records. This project digitizes the entire process.

Key Features
  • Secure login system
  • Property listing management
  • Tenant registration and management
  • Property search functionality
  • Rental request management
  • Full CRUD (Add, Update, Delete, Search) operations
  • Database integration with rent details
  • Responsive, user-friendly interface
Architecture / Workflow

User logs into the application through the secure login system.

Admin manages property listings — adding, updating or removing them.

Tenant information and bookings are stored in a MySQL database.

Users search and browse available properties.

Rental requests are submitted and processed.

All changes flow back through CRUD operations on the database.

Challenges Faced
  • Designing an efficient relational database schema
  • Managing relationships between multiple tables
  • Implementing secure database connectivity
  • Handling CRUD operations efficiently
Learning Outcomes
  • Relational database design
  • SQL query writing
  • PHP and MySQL integration
  • Backend web development
  • Database management using XAMPP
Future Enhancements
  • Online rent payment gateway
  • Email notifications
  • Property image gallery
  • Google Maps integration
  • Analytics dashboard and mobile responsive app
